newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids up as MGE climbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids up as MGE climbs.

text.p: Spring wheat bids were higher on Monday as MGE futures continued to climb but farmer selling was slow as producers waited for more attractive prices, several cash grain dealers said.

"In the country, you don't buy much when the market is up," a Montana dealer said. "A little bit moved on Thursday when (futures) first went up, but then we went even higher Friday and today and that shut things down."
MGE December spring wheat futures closed at $4.01-1/2 on Monday. It was the first time that market closed above $4 since October 29.
Elsewhere in the spring wheat belt, some elevators were closed in observance of Veteran's Day holiday, a Minnesota dealer said.
"It's Veteran's Day and the opening of hunting season was this weekend," he said. "A lot of farmers are out and a good number of (merchants) are, too."
